verdict.rationale: A Hacker News comment cites Morph's own privacy policy: free-tier submitted code data may be used to train models, while Enterprise-tier customers are explicitly excluded from any training use of their data. This shows the capability to prevent training use exists but only via a paid Enterprise plan, not as a default or user-toggleable setting — missing for 10: no official docs in the evidence pack confirming this policy, no self-serve opt-out for free/paid non-enterprise tiers, and no independent verification beyond a single community quote.
